name: living-docs
description: The complete Living Docs toolkit for discovery, technical synchronization, and automated UI snapshots.

actions.name: check_staleness
actions.description: Identifies which documentation files are out of sync with recent code changes.

actions.name: take_snapshot
actions.description: Capture a screenshot of a URL or a specific UI component using a JSON task list.

parameters.name: tasks
parameters.description: Path to the JSON file containing the browser actions.

parameters.name: output-metadata
parameters.description: Optional path to save extracted element information.

actions.name: sync_ui_docs
actions.description: Scans the project for 'snapshot-recipe' blocks in Markdown files and updates all screenshots from the live site.

actions.name: regen_all
actions.description: Runs the full documentation regeneration pipeline: checks for staleness and updates all UI screenshots.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force a visual sync even if no recipe changes are detected.

actions.name: resolve_route
actions.description: Finds the web route (URL) associated with a specific UI component source file.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The path to the UI component file (e.g., .tsx, .jsx).
